title: Zesty Irish Chickpea Flatbread
description: A quick, wine-infused chickpea flatbread with Irish herbs and a crunchy namul blanched mix, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk chickpea flour, salt, pepper, rosemary, thyme, and lemon zest until dry mixture is homogeneous.
Add dry white wine and water gradually, whisking until batter is smooth and free of lumps.
Heat a comal over medium heat and lightly brush with olive oil.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter onto the comal, spreading it into a thin circle.
Cook the flatbread for 3 minutes until bubbles form and the edges lift.
Flip gently and cook the other side for 2 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from heat and let rest 1 minute before slicing.
Serve warm, optionally topped with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkle of fresh herbs.
